method: charter -> rival hypotheses -> discriminating probes -> correction -> verifier -> bounded admission

belief_updates.belief: Source authority and execution placement should be independently composable.
belief_updates.rival: A single ProjectBackend identity is simpler and sufficient.
belief_updates.probe: local/mirror equivalence plus detached-executor mutation probe
belief_updates.observation: cognition remains equivalent, while detached mutation needs a separate fail-closed policy
belief_updates.decision: retain split SourceAuthority + ExecutionProvider beneath compatibility facade

belief_updates.belief: Every language provider should keep workspace-lifetime project state.
belief_updates.rival: provider-specific persistence should be admitted only when lifecycle is explicit and measurable
belief_updates.observation: unbounded Jedi Project retention created hidden lifecycle/performance pressure
belief_updates.decision: reject unbounded Jedi persistence; use bounded LRU + durable semantic partitions; retain persistent TS LanguageService

belief_updates.belief: File-level localization is sufficient for an agent-native explorer.
belief_updates.rival: solver context cost remains high unless exploration is region/line bounded
belief_updates.probe: 202-file distractor fixture under hard line budget
belief_updates.observation: semantic regions select gold auth/billing lines with zero exact-source reads and no noise regions
belief_updates.decision: admit line-budget workspace.explore; exact source remains a Context VM fault

belief_updates.belief: Low-confidence retrieval should still return the best available source.
belief_updates.rival: least-bad source causes avoidable context pollution
belief_updates.probe: quantum banana teleportation matrix no-gold case
belief_updates.observation: calibrated retrieval is low confidence with no supported region
belief_updates.decision: abstain and fault zero source bytes

belief_updates.belief: Execution receipts need only backend identity.
belief_updates.rival: source authority and execution evidence are distinct provenance questions
belief_updates.observation: same cognition can execute under distinct placement

belief_updates.belief: Green tests imply runtime lifecycle health.
belief_updates.rival: process-shared services can survive after result emission
belief_updates.observation: shared services required deterministic host drain
belief_updates.decision: add idempotent shutdown_runtime_services and lifecycle verifier

claim_boundary: Method trace records engineering belief updates and verifiers; it is not evidence of AGI capability.
